title: Inquest called into death of boy killed by father
article: After months of lobbying by the mother of an eight-year-old Brantford boy who was stabbed to death by his father, a coroner's inquest has been called into hisdeath.
Jared Osidacz was killed on March 18. Then his father, Andrew Osidacz, showed up at his ex-partner Julie Craven's home.
Saying he had just killed their son, heheld her hostage at knifepointfor an hour before the police arrived.
"I saw the carving knife coming towards my neck. Just as it came within an inch of my throat, there were sudden gunshots," Craven remembers.
Osidacz was killed by the police gunfire.
While an inquest into her estranged husband's death was automatic because it involved a police officer, it took lobbying to secure an investigation into her son's murder.

The regional supervising coroner for Niagara, Dr. David Eden, said the decision to grant an inquest into this case was made in the hope that it would result in recommendations to prevent similar deaths in the future.
Hedeclined to comment on what specific areas would be examined.
But Craven hopes it answers herbiggestquestion: why was Osidacz granted unsupervised access to their son, even though there were incidents of violence during the marital breakup?
